status: public beta, documentation verified; not live-tested in this research

price.conditions: Regional processing premiums and long-context input multipliers apply. Do not transfer model-level Batch/Flex discounts to this endpoint.

inputs: user messages with input_text and inline input_image

input_limits.image_urls: inline data URLs only; no hosted URL/file_id
input_limits.endpoint_context_tokens: not separately established; model context is not an endpoint limit guarantee

questions.values: string or boolean; typed values are distinct
questions.score: probability-weighted expected index of ordered levels, not free numeric regression
questions.multi_question: guide recommends independent questions sharing input; dependent decisions use sequential requests

response.refusal: per-question typed refusal; may coexist with scored answers
response.confidence: separate field on choice/score; formula not established from inspected docs
response.usage: input/output/total token counters and details; counters do not imply output billing

engineering.batch: not in the currently supported Batch endpoint list or SDK enum
engineering.streaming: SDK lazy-response wrapper exists; no Decisions stream/event contract established
engineering.rate_limits: account/model-dependent; no endpoint-specific numeric throughput established
engineering.latency: vendor claim approximately 10x Responses; no numeric shared benchmark established
engineering.language: Chinese/mixed-language performance not independently established by this research

sources.evidence: model-level pricing/context, not endpoint feature inheritance
official changelog dates public beta to 2026-10-06
